speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are experiencing generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests. To understand the underlying cause, have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or the whites of your eyes (jaundice)?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your history of ulcerative colitis and sexual activity, have you recently started any new medications, particularly for your bowel or blood pressure? REQUEST TEST: Liver function panel (ALT, AST, Alk Phos, Bilirubin), INR, Albumin.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: ALT 78 U/L, AST 75 U/L, Alk Phos 460 U/L, Bilirubin_Total 1.5 mg/dL, Bilirubin_Direct 0.9 mg/dL; INR not provided, Albumin not provided.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC). The combination of severe pruritus, fatigue, scleral icterus, and your history of autoimmune disease (ulcerative colitis) is highly suggestive of this condition; the abnormal liver enzymes likely reflect cholestasis rather than drug toxicity.
